notes.title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged v2.1a Update Patch
notes.content:
[h1][b]Blackthorn Arena: Reforged v2.1a Update Patch[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New content:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added some new innate traits that can be randomly obtained
[*][b]Added a champion of the freeman, “Xuefei”. This mysterious swordsman from the East will appear in the Arena of the Freelands and have the opportunity to fight for you.[/b]
[/list]



[h2][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h2]
[b]System:[/b]
[b]*Fixed a bug where a small number of players were unable to start the game due to video decoding issues
*Fixed a bug where the game could not be played normally when a player encountered a side mission challenge during a tournament.
- Gladiators who are currently undergoing surgery, training Genre, or being tortured in the dark room can no longer be sold.
- Fixed the bug that allowed gladiators who were away/dispatched from the arena to be sold.
- Fixed the bug that caused the damage of the injuring Palm to be overpowered.

[b]Performance:[/b]
- Fixed the bug that the bat would get stuck in the terrain.
- Fixed the bug that occasionally caused the arrow of the bow to get stuck in the hand and not disappear.
- Fixed the bug that after hosting a feast, the gladiators would not return to their posts.
- Fixed an issue where skill tips that did not meet the attribute requirements were incorrectly displayed.

[b]Other:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where some acquired traits were classified as innate traits.
- Removed attribute requirements for some weapon skills.
- Fixed the bug where the damage of the Empty-handed and the Monk's Qi Gathering was too high.
- Fixed the issue where the health potion also restores morale.

[h2][b]Balancing:[/b][/h2]
[b]Overall:[/b]
* The character load limit system has been redesigned: characters now have three load limits: light, medium, and heavy.
[list]
[*] When lightly loaded, the character will receive a certain amount of bonus to dodge, attack speed, movement speed, and stamina saving.
[*]  When heavily loaded, the character will receive a certain amount of penalty to dodge, attack speed, movement speed, and stamina saving.
[*] When medium loaded, there will be no bonus or penalty.
[/list]

-Characters can now dodge charging skills.
- The initial random attributes of the characters in the Role library are now consistent with the initial random attribute range of the market characters.

[b]Weapons and armor:[/b]
- Bows and crossbows now reload immediately after firing
- Bows, crossbows and quivers have had their damage increased by 1.5
- Polearms have had their damage reduced by 1
- Adjusted the stamina cost of some two-handed and polearm weapons, and increased them overall
- Slightly increased the armor resistance of the Freeman
- Slightly increased the attributes and levels of some of the weaker champions


[b]Animations:[/b]
- Power strike :  The animation speed  has been reduced by 20
- Lunge : The animation speed has been increased by 30
- Bow and Crossbow: The animation speed of the attack and reload has been increased by 20

[b]Skills:[/b]
- Injuring Palm:   Remove the damage of time effect. Its damage type changed from sustained to soul damage.
- Martial arts master: Resistance penetration has been reduced from a maximum of 75% to 50%, but it will increase the basic damage of the maximum 6% physical strength vaule.
- Quick Heal: The life recovery speed has been reduced from 4/6/8 to 2/3/4
- Power Strike: The cooldown has been increased from 12 seconds to 15 seconds, and the Stamina consumption has been increased from 1.5 times the weapon value to 2 times

[h2][b]Improvements:[/b][/h2]
[b]Features:[/b]
[b]* When creating a custom character in role library, players can now select initial traits under certain rules. [/b]
- When selling and buying gladiators, you can now also view the gladiator's equipment.
- When viewing a character, you can now view his equipment.
- The automatic save before reading the dispatch task is now not repeated when the task is executed again.

[b]UI:[/b]
- The UI for selecting the initial gladiator at the start of the game has been improved.
- When viewing a character in the purchase interface, hovering the mouse over the genre will display an introduction to the genre's characteristics.
- Players will now be given more obvious prompts when they obtain items.
- Buffs now display the duration on the icon.
- The UI of the match and mission settlement screen has been optimized. Excess loot now no longer extends beyond the UI frame, but is displayed using a slider.

[b]Scenarios:[/b]
[b]* In the sewer scene of some missions, the character can now fall into the water and climb back up the ladder.[/b]
- Improved lighting effects in multiple scenes

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena Luner Year Update Patch!
notes.content:
Blackthorn Arena Luner Year Update Patch!

[h1][b]Blackthorn Arena Luner Year update patch.[/b][/h1]

[b]P.S：The system will force the character to have only one archive in Ironman mode, and you cannot save the game manually. At this stage there are still some problems with Ironman mode, which may lead to corrupted archives, data loss or stuck story. Therefore we strongly recommend you to reconsider whether you want to enable this mode. Crash or abnormal exit of the game in Ironman mode can easily cause damage or loss of archive data, so please don't force the game to close in Ironman mode.[/b]

[h1][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h1]

1) Fixed the bug that the character may turn purple after the specific BUFF effect ends.

2) Fixed the bug that the automatic archive could not be loaded after quitting in the middle of challenging the orc master in Ironman mode.

3) Fixed the bug that the effect of level 1-3 of the Energy Shield of the monk was the same.

4) Fixed the bug that dispatching servants to buy recipes from the market could not take any 7effect.

5) Fix the bug that dragging stackable items to the original position of the item bar would cause the items to disappear has been fixed.

6) Fix The bug that the attribute bonus of "Wolf Type" and "Bear Type" did not increase with level.

7) Fixed a bug that caused the animation to get stuck after transforming.

8) Fixed a bug that the CD of unavailable skills would not be displayed normally in the transformed state.

9) Fixed a bug that caused Grab-type skills acting on a target at the same time would cause the target's position to be misplaced.

10) Fixed the bug that some monsters killed with Grab Attack in Transformed Mode might not be able to pick up the loot from the corpse.

11) Fixed the bug that issuing multiple skill casting commands in Command Company or using multiple skills in a row in a trigger action may cause the skill casting after the one in the row to be interrupted.

12) Accelerated the casting speed of transforming to avoid the probability of transforming skill casting being interrupted.

[h1][b]Improvements:[/b][/h1]

1) Optimizates the character models, slightly improving game performance.

2) Optimized several localizations.

New content:

[b]A new freelance champion, Sixteen Nights (Yizayoi), has been added. She is a female ronin from the eastern country of Asago who wears a suit of black armor and is called Yoiyami. She can be refreshed in the very late archives.
[/b]
      Originally a member of the Shogunate's assassin organization in Asarai, nikenamed Genki, Yizayoi specializes in kendo, ninjutsu, and assassination. She was taught harshly from a young age by a court ninja master, and by the age of fifteen she had acquired the skills to begin working for the Shogunate. One day, Yizayoi was assigned a mission to assassinate the princess of a neighboring country. When she managed to infiltrate the princess's residence and saw her target, Yizayoi was surprised to find that the person she had to kill was a young girl two years younger than herself, who looked totally innocent. Yizayoi could not accept to let such an innocent girl die under her own hands and become a victim of political struggle, she resolutely chose to give up her mission and accept the fate of being hunted by the organization and her own teacher, no matter where she goes. She began to roam all over the world.

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena Game of the year Edition Update!
notes.content:
Dear Blackthorn Arena Players:
      Thank you very much for your continued support and love, and I'm sorry to have kept you waiting for so long. Today, Blackthorn Arena has finally received the biggest update since its official release. The reason this update took so long is because we spent a lot of effort optimizing the game, and the good news is that it was worth the time and we made a lot of progress with the optimization. Of course, there is no proof in the words, you have to enter the game and experience it for yourself. In addition the store page our new CRPG game Age of Reforging: Blackthorn has also been revealed. Add to wishlist if you are interested!

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1665680/]New DLC :  The Roar From the North[/url][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1665680/_/
We've released a new DLC, The Roar From The North, along with this major update
It includes a new story, a new northern barbarian faction and its gladiatorial arena, three new sets of legendary armor and a legendary weapon, plus a powerful shapeshifter class to unlock. Interested parties are welcome to check out the store page to purchase.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161830/_/]New Game-  Age of Reforging : Blackthorn[/url][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161830/_/
In addition, we have just released the store page for our new game in development, Age of Reforging: Blackthorn. It is a CRPG that puts players in the role of a legendary gladiator who reclaims his freedom, overthrows the rule of the gladiatorial lords, abolishes slavery in the Freelands, and fights the dark and evil forces that threaten the entire Freehold. In addition, players are free to explore the entire Freelands and write their own legends.
Age of Reforging: Blackthorn follows the same worldview, combat system, and character system as Blackthorn Arena. But there will be a lot of new skills and equipment. In addition, its plot is also inextricably linked to "Blackthorn Arena".  You are now free to add it to your wishlist!

Please note that the game of the year edition of Blackthorn Arena does not mean the end of updates and maintenance for Blackthorn Arena. Although we have started development on a new project, we will still dedicate enough effort to regularly update and maintain Blackthorn Arena and bring new content to you in the future. In addition, after this update, we strongly recommend players to start a new game to play Blackthorn Arena in order to ensure the best gaming experience. We have tried to make the new version as compatible as possible with the old saves, but there may still be some unforeseen problems with the old saves.

 The following is the specific content of this major update：

[h1][b]Blackthorn Arena Anniversary Edition Updates (Free Content):[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h2]

1) Fixed the problem of incorrect display of the effects of the monk's Energy Burst skill.

2) Fixed the bug that the Commander's passive effect only works on itself.

3) Fixed a bug that the animation would occasionally turn into empty hand animation when weapons are equipped.

4) Fixed the bug that browsing market goods in Blackthorn Arena, the goods of material merchant are not refreshed.

5) Fixed a bug that caused a black screen when passing a turn when some skills of the ronin class were included in the growth plan.

6) Fixed the bug that the mouse hovering over the Buff icon did not show the Buff description.

[h2][b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Performance:[/b][/h3]

1) After six months of hard work and overcoming countless difficulties, we've finally achieved very significant results in game optimization!

2) We have upgraded the Unity engine version from 2020.1 to 2020.3 long-term support version. This version is theoretically more stable and efficient, and program crashes will be greatly reduced.

3) Improved the way the entire game resources are packaged and managed, now the game runs with a significantly lower memory footprint.

4) Optimized the way the game is loaded, now the loading speed is dramatically increased.

[h3][b]Scenes:[/b][/h3]

1) Baked the lighting of some indoor scenes, reduced the amount of real-time lighting and improved the FPS of the scene.

2) Improved the pathfinding function of some scenes.

3) Beautified some of the dispatch mission scenes and enriched the environment effects.

4) Characters fighting in the arena are now less likely to get stuck outside the arena (we are not sure if this can be 100% avoided, but it is foreseeable that the probability of this happening has been greatly reduced).

[h3][b]Character models.[/b][/h3]

1) Added dynamic swing effects to all long hair.

2) Added character customization options for body fat percentage, age, scars, blemishes, etc.

3) Added character makeup system, you can choose eye shadow, eyeliner, blush and lipstick for your character.

4) Improved the random mechanism of character appearance, so that the random character appearance is more abundant and diverse.

5) Made LODs for character models, reducing the performance consumption of character models.

6) Added dynamic effects to some advanced equipment to make it look more dynamic and natural.

7) Remake the models of all slave equipment.

8) Remake the models of all veteran sets.

9) Remake the models of the Ranger set, Assassin set and Monster Butcher set.

[h3][b]Gameplay:[/b][/h3]

1) Unlocked genres are recorded and can be unlocked at the start of the new game, though players' 
characters still have to learn these genres through genre training in the training ground.

2) A new attribute type has been added - Block Break It reduces the probability of the opponent blocking. This attribute is mostly applied to the newly added flail weapons.

[h2][b]NEW CONTENT:[/b][/h2]

1) 4 new weapon types: Light Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow, Flail and Two-Handed Flail, each with 5 different qualities and including a legendary weapon with special effects.

- Light crossbow: long-range weapon, compared to most bows, attack speed is slightly lower, but has good armor penetration and high single shot damage.

- Heavy Crossbow: A long-range weapon with a lower attack speed than a light crossbow, but with even higher armor penetration and single shot damage.

- Flail: One-handed weapon, with long attack distance, slow attack speed and high damage fluctuation.

- Two-handed Flail: two-handed weapon, long attack distance, large attack range, slow attack speed, high damage fluctuation, can bypass blocking.

2) Added a system of enemies between gladiators. 
- Gladiators now consider opponents who have defeated them, or killed their friends, as enemies. When encountering a enemy, gladiators will receive bonuses to damage and attack speed, as well as being more likely to go into a rampage.

3) Freelancers will now participate in gladiatorial games held in all the arenas.
- Five freelancer legendary champions have been added, and they will appear in the game alongside the other gladiatorial champions after the Spring Game.
- Each freelancer champion has their own unique armor and weapons, as well as traits.
- The freelancer champions will randomly come to the Blackthorn Arena to challenge players during the game, and if players defeat them, they can take them under their wing. In addition, it is possible to meet these legendary gladiators in the field during the extremely difficult slave capture missions.

[b]These five freelancer champions are:[/b]
Galu : A bruteman two-handed warrior.
Mous: A dwarf ranger.
Lorren: An elven archer.
Kureha: A human Ronin.
Lavinia: A human gladiator.

4) Added 6 new generic traits.
- Intelligent +2 Intelligence
- Agile +2 Agility
- Strong +2 Strength
- Sturdy +2 Stamina
- Steadfast +2 Willpower
- Sensitive +2 Precision
These traits will appear in the trait list of random characters when new characters are created.

[h2][b]BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS:[/b][/h2]

[h3]Overall.[/h3]
1) A player's champion character(those who with the gold portrait background) can no longer be executed, sold, or customize their appearance, and champion characters no longer take up a player's gladiator cap.

2) Each player's available champion character now has its own unique trait.

3) Characters will now only cancel activated status skills two seconds later after they disengage from the combat.

[h3]Items.[/h3]

1) Iron Torch: Damage reduced from 16-21 to 12-18.

[h3]Skills.[/h3]

1) Ronin.
- Smoke Pill's own unselectable effect duration reduced from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena Anniversary Celebration！
notes.content:
Dear Blackthorn Arena players.
	Blackthorn Arena has finally celebrated its first anniversary since its release! We would like to thank all the players for their support for this year.
	With the help of your support, our game has grown and improved a lot, but we are also aware that it has a series of problems and shortcomings. Even so, you still gave us the greatest degree of tolerance and understanding, which is the greatest wealth for such a lack of funds and experience of independent game studio. We will continue to do our best to improve and perfect Blackthorn Arena, and will continue to develope more games in the future!
	We plan to release the Anniversary Edition of Blackthorn Arena at the end of June! This update will be the biggest update since the official release of Blackthorn Arena, with many improvements ,optimizations and a lot of new content. We're also releasing a new DLC with new equipment, a new gladiatorial arena, and a new unique skill tree. Stay tuned!

[h1][b]In the free update, you can expect the following :[/b][/h1]

1) A complete upgrade and improvement of the character models. More details, more adjustable options and more customization content.

2) Five freelance legendary gladiatiors make their debut! Each of them has a unique set of equipment and has the potential to join the player during the course of the game. In addition, the Freelancers will also participate as an independent force in the various tournaments in the Freeland.

3) Several new weapon types will be added to the game: crossbows, heavy crossbows, shackles, and two-handed shackles. Of course, each new weapon type will include a legendary-quality weapon.

4) The models of several old pieces of equipment have been redone, and the new models will be more detailed.

5) Enhanced interaction between gladiators and players.

6) New achievements, new traits, new events.

7) New tournament mode.

8) Significant optimization of game efficiency. The updated game will be more stable and smooth.

9) Fixes for some leftover bugs.

In addition, our game studio's new project - "Age of Reforger: Blackthorn" will also be revealed for the first time at the end of July!  Add to wishlist if you are interested!

- End Turn
End the current character's action turn. Up to 50% of the remaining action points will be saved for the next turn.

- Rest
Ends the current character's action turn and enters a rest state. Increases the health and stamina point restore amount at the end of the turn by a percentage equal to the percentage of action points remaining.

- Defense
Ends the current character's action turn and enters a rest state. Increases the health and stamina point restore amount at the end of the turn by a percentage equal to the percentage of action points remaining.

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena v 1.2 Major Update! （Half- Online Mode)

[h1][b]Overall improvement:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]The Unity engine version has been upgraded from 2018.2 to 2020.1. [/b][/h3]
        We consume a lot of time porting the engine of the game to the 2020.1 version. This work is full of difficulties and challenges, but based on the current results, we think it is worthwhile. The new version of the Unity engine is more stable and efficient, it also has a more beautiful 3D rendering effect. Through this upgrade, "Blackthorn Arena" will theoretically become more stable, reducing the chance of being collapsed, and the game's framerate becoming more smooth as well. Most scenes' FPS has been improved to a certain extent. In addition, thanks to the improvement of Unity rendering technology, the light and shadow effects of the game have also been improved.
[b]Shadow effect before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262817/15c9cf5ffbac533d3097df2d80481521ceae5df6.png[/img]

[h3][b] Notice:  All game resources will be repackaged due to the huge changes brought about by this engine upgrade. Players who perform this update will have to re-download the updated content that is close to the entire game size. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience! [/b][/h3]

    In the process of upgrading the engine, due to the large engine version span, we encountered various problems, most of them have been solved, however,  there are still some stubborn problems that do not hinder the progress of the game yet to be solved.
Currently, known issues/bugs include: On low-configuration computers, UI flickering may occur when the frame rate is low. This problem can be solved temporarily [h3][b]by turning off/down the shadow effect[/b][/h3].
   In addition, due to our limited testing capabilities, the new version of the game may have some minor issues that we have not yet discovered. If you encounter any problems, please give us feedback in the game forum or official discussion group, and we will deal with these problems as quickly as possible.


[h1][b]Other improvements:[/b][/h1]

1) Now the list of gladiators (the characters panel) can be swiped by the mouse wheel.

2) The purchased materials will be automatically stacked in the inventory.

3) It is now possible to replace/swape the character in the battle by dragging the gladiator avatar to the battle bar.

4) Now the "practice combat" in the training ground will reset the cooldown time of participants' skills and talents.

5) In the caravan robbing side mission, the merchant will stop and begging for mercy when all the guards died.

6) Optimized the highlight display effect.

7) Improved some animations.

8) The transition between animations is smoother.

9) Adjusted the attachment point of the character's bow and arrow to make it look more natural.


[h1][b]New content:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]1) New system : Non-real-Time Online PVP mode (Half-Online mode)[/b][/h2]
     Players can now upload their own gladiators to our server! We have added a button to the main menu to go to the "Gortus' shrine", where players can browse the gladiators uploaded by other players, or upload the gladiators in their local archives. Each player can upload four teams, and each team's size is limited to 1, 2, 3, and 4 gladiators. Players can also choose any team on the online leaderboard and click Challenge to fight with them! In addition, if the uploader allows, players can download the Gladiator’s pinch data, growth plan, and tactical triggers uploaded by other players.

2) Online Growth Plan system has been added to the Role library:
    We have added a feature to browse all the growth plan uploaded by other players in the role library. Here players can browse and download any growth plan uploaded by anyone to the local, or share their own local growth plan to the server.

[h2][b]3) Custom difficulty:[/b][/h2]
      Now players can choose custom difficulty and adjust each difficulty factor separately when starting a new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262817/6e6da9bfb3ab8626a409febba30fc94bce2dd429.png[/img]

4) New event-Freeman challenge
    Occasionally, some free men will come to challenge your Arena. According to the rules of the Freeland, free men can place a bet. The bet can be money, goods or even their own freedom. If the challenger wins, they will get a lot of money from you. If they lose, they will lose their bet.

[h2][b]5) New special event! [/b][/h2]
   In the middle and late stages of the game, a wandering samurai named " Lin " will come to your arena and ask to challenge your gladiators. Her bet is her own freedom and she wants to take a lot of gold from you! If you accept the challenge and defeat her in a one-on-one battle. This unique character will become your slave.

6) A new set of the Legendary armor
Red lotus armor set:  When damaging an enemy, restores the character's health by 25% of the it's damage .
The wandering Samurai Lin will wear this set of legendary Samurai armor. Defeat her to obtain this armor!

7) A legendary katana:
Sakura fall: The chance of "countercut" is doubled.

8) Two new short samurai swords (Wakizashi)

9) Three new traits:
-Heavy fist: Empty hand damage increased by 15% (fist weapon will not share this bonus).
-Armor maintainer: The weight of all armors is reduced by 5%.
-Drugster : Willpower -2, but the effect of recovery potions, morale potions and experience potions increased by 25%


[h1][b] Balance adjustment:
[/b][/h1]
-Decreased the reward of God's grace for the Gortus' Eternal Challenge from 10000 to 2000.

[h1][b]Summary and Future Plan:[/b][/h1]

       After three months of full supplemental development, Blackthorn Arena has finally reached a state where we think the content is more ideal and rich.

[h3][b]The current version contains:[/b][/h3]
[b]- 13 Arenas with different styles
-15 Legendary NPC Champion with their unique battle style.
-7 different Weapon masteries ( One-Handed, Two-Handed, Weapon&Shield, Ranged Weapon, Dual Weapon,  Polearms, Unarmed)
-9 unique class/genres ( Gladiator, Commander, Duelist, Defender, Rogue, Ranger, Berserker, Marksman, BattleMonk)
-160 different skills for players to freely combine and collocate.
-After continuous updates, we have increased the number of equipment in the game to a staggering 500 pieces, including 24 legendary weapons and 8 legendary armors sets for players to obtain. [/b]

    In addition, we have solved a lot of bugs and made plenty of balance adjustments. We are confident that the current version can provide new coming or restarting/returning players the most complete game experience so far. Of course, this is not the end. This is just what the "Blackthorn Arena" suppose to look like. In the future, we will continue to introduce more content updates and game mechanism improvements. Thanks to all the players who have supported us so far!

     Our previous Update preview mentioned a turn-based combat system. We have completed the preliminary development of this system, however, due to its complexity, there are still many problems waited to be solved. After a period of testing, we are afraid that the turn-based combat mode is not ready to face players yet. Therefore, this update will not include the option of turn-based mode, however,  we promise to add this mode in a later update. For now, We hope the players who are interested in turn-based mode could wait patiently for a short period of time.

     In addition, during the boring process of upgrading the engine, we have been thinking about adding more interesting and cool content to the Blackthorn Arena. Well, here is the plan! As you can see in this update, we have added a lot of equipment related to the style of Japanese samurai, and this is just the beginning. We will create two new class/weapon masteries around the two popular elements - Japanese samurai and ninja, a series of new equipment, a brand-new "Dojo" arena, and an interesting new side story (a ninja group from a far eastern country will visit the Freeland, setting off in this land that never lacks surprises). This part of the content will be presented to the players in the next major update.  Stay tuned and we hope you could all enjoy this major update!

If you have any advice, feedback or bug reports, please leave your comment below.

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena v1.1 - God of Wars Major Update! (Localization Supported)
notes.content:
Dear players in the Blackthorn Gladiator:
   Greeting, thank you very much for your support and patience during this time, Blackthorn Arena finally moves towards its next level. The following is the content of 1.1 major updates. In addition, we launched a new DLC: Blackthorn Arena - Gods of War Expansion Pack. It contains a new story mission and a new story challenge. The final rewards are two sets of legendary armor symbolizing the goddess of victory, Alyanas, and the god of war, Gortus. You are most welcome to go to the store page to view detailed information:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352030/_/


Dear players in the Blackthorn Gladiator:
   Greeting, thank you very much for your support and patience during this time, Blackthorn Arena finally moves towards its next level. The following is the content of 1.1 major updates. In addition, we launched a new DLC: Blackthorn Arena - Gods of War Expansion Pack. It contains a new story mission and a new story challenge. The final rewards are two sets of legendary armor symbolizing the goddess of victory, Alyanas, and the god of war, Gortus. You are most welcome to go to the store page to view detailed information:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352030/_/


[h1]Blackthorn Arena v1.1- Gods of War Major update: [/h1]
(The following updates are not related to DLC)


[h2][b] Massive new content: [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]1) Localization support: [/b][/h3]

[b]Added localization of French, German, Italian, Spanish and Russian to the game (Due to time constraints, some languages ​​have imperfections, we will improve as soon as possible in the next two weeks,  we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience )[/b]

The localization of Korean is still in progress and will be updated in two weeks!

[h3][b]2) Add a "Growth plan" system: [/b][/h3]

Players will be able to create own "Growth plan" ( template of how to assign each skill points, potential point to attribution, Genre and weapon mastery, etc..) in the role library, or save one of their existing characters as a specific "Growth plan", and apply this template to their own characters. The characters will automatically learn skills and assign attribute points according to the "Growth plan" when upgrading.

[h3][b]3) Powerful Epithet NPC gladiator: [/b][/h3]
We have built more than twenty sets of NPC's  Growth plans. NPC gladiators have a certain probability to apply these Growth plans to replace the previous random growth. This kind of Epithet NPC gladiators will theoretically become stronger as the game progresses, and an epithet/nickname will appear in their name for players to distinguish:

Gladiator-Two Hands:  Gatebreaker
Commander-Long Handle: Bellwether 
Defender-Shield: Stronghold
Duel-One Hand: Sparrowhawk 
Thieves-Dual Wield: Windblade
Ranger-Bow and Arrow: Firewatch
Marksman-Bow and Arrow: Watchtower 
Berserker-Dual Wield: Redeye
Gladiator-Defender-Two Hands: Chevalier 
Gladiator-Berserker-Hands: Butcher 
Gladiator-Duelist-Long handle: Juggernaut
Gladiator-Rogue-One-handed: Shadowless 
Commander-Defender-Shield: General
Commander-Marksman-Bow and Arrow: Beaconfire
Defender-Berserker-Shield: Shieldmaiden
Duelist-Commander-Long Handle: Warmaster 
Thieves-Duelist-One-handed: Rascal 
Rogue-Ranger-Bow Arrow: Cobra
Thieves-Berserker-Dual Wield: Drunkman 
Ranger-Marksman-Bow and Arrow: Mistwalker
Monk-Gladiator-Long Handle: Musha 
Monk-Duelist-One-handed: Mindeye
Monk-Defender-Two Hands: Mountainpeak
Monk-Berserker-Dual Wield: Madmonk

[h3][b]4) Gortus' Enternal Challenge: [/b][/h3]

The shrine of Gods of War Gortus will now be open to players before the Grand Ventiones. Here, players will encounter an endless challenge against ten groups of powerful monsters. Each time you win the challenge, you will receive the grace of Gortus, which can be used to exchange legendary equipment with the sacrifice of the Shrine. In the Eternal challenge, once the player defeats all 10 groups of monsters, the challenge will enter the next level, and all monsters will come back and become more powerful, and of course, the reward will also double.

[h3][b]5) New Arena-  Gortus' Shrine. [/b][/h3]

-Added a total of 6 new epic and legendary amulets.

-Added a legendary belt and a legendary cloak.

[h3][b]6) New arena—Izziel Temple. [/b][/h3]

One month before the spring game, the Izziel temple, located in the mysterious Kadar rainforest, will be open to players. The Temple of Izziel resembles an arena, but its gladiators are all monks. They have unique monk genre skills, use fist and war sticks as weapons, and will be powerful opponents that players will encounter in the middle of the game. Not only that, but the Temple of Izziel will also open the challenge to the player. After the first challenge, the player would obtain a scroll that can unlock the unarmed weapon mastery and the battle monk genre.

[h3][b]7) New weapon mastery:  Unarmed! （Unlock by Storyline) [/b][/h3]

The Unarmed weapon skill can be used without any weapons or only with a fist (a few skills are not compatible with fist). The unarmed skill is flexible, and most of them have a control effect. However, the disadvantage of unarmed skills are also obvious - The damage is not as strong as others and unarmed skills are not very good at defense.

[h3][b]8) New genre: Battle Monk! （Unlock by Storyline)[/b][/h3]

The monk is a mysterious battle genre from the Eastern Kingdom Singhi. The Izziel sect Spread the monk to the rest of the world. Monks are good at manipulating mysterious inner energy to fight and can be used to protect themselves or to increase the strength of the attack on the enemy. It can even launch a powerful shock wave to attack the enemy from a distance. In addition, the monk has very good maneuverability, and can quickly change positions on the battlefield.

- In the main while, three sets of monk suits have been added to the game. Players can obtain it by participating in competitions held in the Temple of Izziel or by completing treasure hunt side missions.
- Two new "helmets" have been added: Banboo hat and Iron hat.
- Added two new legendary champions to the game, they all belong to Izziel Temple. Yes, they are the Masters - Two most powerful monk champions in Izziel Temple. They will also appear in important games at the same time.

[h3][b]9) Two new weapons have been added! Four for each department. [/b][/h3]

1. Stick weapons. Stick weapons can be regarded as two-handed weapons and Polearm weapons at the same time.
2. Fist weapon. Fist weapons can be regarded as one-handed weapons and Unarmed at the same time.

[h3][b]10) Five new legendary weapons have been added: [/b][/h3]

-Justice: Attacks have a 33% chance of crushing the target's armor, reducing its physical resistance by 25% for 4 seconds.
-Spear of Destiny: There is a 50% chance of turning a critical strike you receive into a non-critical strike.
-Frozen tooth: Attack will apply frost to the target, reduce its attack speed and movement speed by 30%, and suppress its health recovery by 5 points for 2 seconds.
-Zander's truncheon： Zander's truncheon: The duration of the Energy Shield is increased by 200%.
-Lekha's claw： The duration of all sustained damage (damage of Dot) effects is doubled.

[h3][b]11) New monster: [/b][/h3]
- Chimera: It will appear in "Very Hard" hunting side mission or certain specific venationes, it will drop advanced alchemy materials.
- Wyvern: It will become the player's biggest challenge in some form.
- Several rare materials of the advanced monsters have been added to the game.

[h3][b]12) New recipe: [/b][/h3]
- Rebirth Potion: Return all potential points and reset the character's all current attribute points to 5 .
- Food recipe: Griffon omelette

[h3][b]13) Others: [/b][/h3]
- Added execution animation to the game.
- Added a new side mission map. (Spider's Nest)
- Two new legendary champions: Alyanas' chosen champion- Bianca and Gortus' chosen champion - Adrian, will appear in the NPC arena and become a strong enemy in the middle/ late game (if the player purchases Gods of War DLC, they will only appear under certain circumstances).

[h3][b]14) Online Leaderboard : ( will update in two weeks)[/b][/h3]
Online leaderboards will allow players to upload their gladiators to the online server as well as download other players' gladiators' data to their local! This function is currently in progress and will update within 2-3 weeks.


[h2][b]Improvement: [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]1) Overall: [/b][/h3]

-Reclassified the game's sound effects to make the audio control sliders more helpful, Now the game should be able to completely silent.
-The permanent attribute potions that have been used now appear in the character trait list, which helps to remind players which characters have consumed which attribute potions.
-All of the gladiator's skills and talents will now reset the CD at the beginning of a new match.
-The character's standing animation has been reworked to make it more natural and smooth.
-Beautified the living area and training area of the Blackthorn Arena.
-Improved the initial camera angle of all dispatch quest scenes, and a hint will show when the player entered an unwalkable area.
-Reworked all sewer scenes. Now their paths are wider, and players can descend into the water through ladders.
-Optimized the occlusion handing system of almost all the arena, and added air walls to keep the fighters inside the battle area.
-Reduced the trigger chance of gladiator argue events.
-Modified the appearance of some armor and added dynamic cloth effect to some advanced skirts.

[h3][b]2) UI: [/b][/h3]

-Added some tips about some obscure but helpful game information on the loading screen.
-Improved the UI in the management scene and added some handy shortcut keys.
-The buff's tooltip now shows its creator.
-The character status panel now displays the character's weapon type, block angle, attack angle, and various resistance penetration values.
-Added different icons to all belts.
-During the battle, you can see the blood bars of both parties

[h3][b]3) Trigger: [/b][/h3]

-Added copy and save buttons to the trigger. You can now copy a trigger to another character, and you can save a trigger to a local database for any character in any archive to use.
-Added more command target to the trigger: self, event enemy, event ally, nearest ally, current attack target, nearest enemy, highest health enemy, lowest health enemy, highest level enemy, lowest level enemy enemy.
-Added "AND" and "OR" logic switcher to trigger condition.
-Added target's weapon type and armor type in the condition.
-You can now dray a trigger up and down.


[h2][b]Balance adjustment:[/b][/h2]

1) Duelist: Countercut now has a smoother animation.

2) Khal Dela: Disarm effect trigger chance increased from 18% to 30%.

3) Duelist's glory: Block rate bonus reduced from 15 to 12, dodge rate bonus reduced from 10 to 8.

4) Slightly reduced the weapon damage of Orc Master.

5) A large number of monsters' attributes have been adjusted, and middle-level monsters have been more strengthened.

6) Reduced Cyclops' skill damage.

7) Balance adjustments were made to the attributes, skills, and equipments of several champions.

8) Change Kiara - the champion of the Terrell Arena to a dual-wielding berserker, and the new legendary axe Frosttooth will now be her offhand weapon.

9) Skills:
-Ranger: Double shots now reduces the attack distance by 4 meters.
-Polearms: Stretching attack is changed to Sweeping attack, and increased attack distance is changed to increase attack angle.


[h2][b]Bug fix:[/b][/h2]

1) Fixed a bug that, in a tag match the death of both sides at the same time would cause the game to get stuck.

2) Fixed a bug that could cause the Blackthorn armor mission to get stuck.

3) Fixed a bug where activating skills will be canceled immediately after activation.

4) Fixed a bug where the tracking target may get lost.

5) Fixed a bug where an extra crit rate was added to a Rogue's surprise attack.

6) Fixed a bug that could trigger the passive effect of Berserker from a ranged weapon

7) Fixed a bug where the player gets challenged event won't spawn.

8) Fixed a bug where the achievement of the Intermediate gladiator master would not be unlocked correctly.

9) Fixed the bug that the game cannot continue after a match is over because the UI is hidden.

10) Fixed a bug where Centaur archers cannot shot arrows.

11) Fixed some traits that show the wrong requirements of the race.

12) Fixed a bug where the hidden helmet function sometimes fails.

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena v 1.0 + 1.1 Major Update Plan!
notes.content:
Dear players of the Blackthorns arena:
              We sincerely apologize for the delay of the update, the large update we originally planned to launch at the end of June will be postponed until mid-July. This is mainly due to two reasons: 

First of all, after we made a lot of new content and tested it, the performance of the test is not very satisfactory. We would like to ask  a little more time to polish and improve some Details; 

Secondly, we will add localization of five new languages ​​after the update (respectively Italian, French, German , Spanish and Russian), and our translators will need time to supplement the translation of new content since the official release in order to provide a localized experience that is as complete as possible. 

In general, we hope that the updated version 1.1 (we will both update 1.0 + 1.1 in the same time)  will become a fairly complete and stable version,  so  we would like to ask for more time to polish the game carefully and optimize all the unsatisfactory details.

Therefore, the content of this update will be more abundant than any of our previous updates, and it will be worth your wait.

[h2][b]The following are the main contents of the major 1.1 update :[/b][/h2]

1) Multiple optimizations of UI and sound effects.

[b]2) A new special arena : The temple of the god of war Gortus.[/b]

[b]3) New post-challenge :  Gortus' Endless Challenge.[/b]

4) Several new legendary weapons.

5) Several new monsters.

6) Add a new kind of side mission map.

7) New build template system :  Some NPC gladiators will automatically use build template. (In addition to the current NPC champion, NPC gladiators will have a large number of powerful(epic) gladiators )

8) The AI ​​trigger has been greatly improved.

9) Add a new plot mission.

[b]10) New  weapon skill and Genre : Martial arts and Monk （ Monk might need another week of time to import into the game) [/b]

[b]11) New online leaderboard system: players can upload or download their own or other players' gladiator data while challenging other players' championships! (Half online mode)[/b]

12) A new DLC, including a new plot mission and a new plot competition. The final rewards are two sets of legendary armor symbolizing the goddess of victory, Alyanas, and the god of war, Gortus.

In addition to the above, other interesting content will be added.

We once again apologize for the delay in our update and also thank you players for your continued support and understanding of the Blackthorn Gladiator. We will also work harder to improve the game. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please leave your comment below.

notes.title: A lettter to Blackthorn Arena Players
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear players：[/b][/h2]
      I hope you enjoyed this weekend.
    I wrote this letter with mixed feelings since the official release of the Blackthorn arena three days ago.
    On the one hand, we were delighted that we have archived a goal that we are working for a long time, which is to develop and publish our first game. On the other hand, I feel anxious and guilty because of the unsatisfactory performance of the game in the past three days. Here, first of all, please allow us to say sorry to all the players who have been troubled by the deficiencies and defects of the game. We are committed to working as fast as possible to solve the game's problems and further improve and enrich the game content.
    Also, we would like to thank all of you, especially those of you who have already joined us in Early Access, for your valuable comments and suggestions on the steam community and our Twitter. Since the release of the game, we have felt the players' tolerance and support for independent games, and many players have spontaneously participated in game testing, which has greatly helped our development work. Here we would like to extend our sincere thanks to all the players.
Blackthorn arena is our studio's first work. I'm sure you don't know much about our studio. Due to limited funds and no former reputation, we have been focused on the development and rarely exposed to media. If you are interested in our studio, please let me give you a brief introduction to the current situation of the studio.
    Our studio was established two years ago, it is consists of a dozen young people who love video games but never get a chance to work on one. Many of our members, including the initiator, are fresh graduates from college. Everyone is new to game development, and no one has ever participated in developing a game before. In the process of development, we encountered a lot of difficulties and challenges, due to lack of experience, every step we made can be very tough.
Also, our funds are very tight. There were no resources for previous projects, no commercial capital injections, and the two founders paid for the entire development process out of their own pockets. It's not uncommon to see comments from players about rough modeling, rough scenes, etc. Let's just say that this is the best that can be done on a limited budget.
In the process of development, we also encountered many difficulties. At the beginning of the project, we were actually planning to make a CRPG game similar to Baldur's Gate, Dragon age, Divinity: Origin sin. However, due to a lack of experience, I underestimated the difficulty of developing a CRPG game. In the middle of development, we realized that the funding available was insufficient to support the entire development process. Therefore, we changed our plan to make a small arena simulation games in the midway. Maybe a lot of players have also found our combat system and skill system are similar to an RPG game. Because the development of the existing game used the resources of the RPG game we were making.
      We know that many players are not very happy with the current released version of the game. Some are disappointed at the game’s graphics, some people think our design has some defects, and balance is not done. The most criticized part of the game is the annoying bugs. We accept all this criticism because, for us, it has not yet grown into what we want it to be. But under the pressure of reality, we have to present it to you now. Here, we pledge to support the game for the long term, solve the existing issues as soon as possible, and add a lot of new free content. We also hope players can give us some understanding and tolerance on our gritty, unpolished debut after knowing the condition of our studio.
     As for the CRPG we mentioned earlier, we are also considering further development, and all players who purchase the Blackthorn arena will be entitled to a discount.
With such an inexperienced team and so limited funds, if we compare the development process to a game, I think we chose the highest difficulty and ironman mode at the beginning. Honestly, it was a regrettable decision from my current view. But life cannot restart just like the game, right? Now, we are worrying about that the game’s income could not cover its cost, we are afraid of losing money. But we won’t lose our love of games, as long as we can earn enough money to continue to make games, continue to do the job that we love, we won’t make a stop.
     Two years ago, we chose to develop indie games. Now we are on the road and we are not going back. It would be a great pleasure to have your company.
Finally, to all the people who like our game, sincerely say: thank you!
                                                                                                                                         Persona Games

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena Official Released!
notes.content:
Dear players of the Blackthorn Arena, after more than a month of hard work, we are very happy to finally present the full official version of the Blackthorn Arena to every players! There are many changes from the EA version to the official version. We are not be able to list every single update one by one. We will only introduce some major new additions and updates. [b]Although the old save files could still be working, we still highly recommend that players open a complete new start.[/b]

[h1][b]New content:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Brand new game mode ! Side missions:[/b][/h2]

After the plot develops to a certain stage, the game will open the function of sending gladiators to perform side missions outside the arena. There are four major types of missions: robbing caravans, capturing slaves, hunting monsters, and exploring for treasures. In addition, more than twenty maps for missions have been added. They have different styles, and some of them offer players the experience of exploration. By sending gladiators to perform these side missions, your gladiator will gain large reward such as capturing new slaves,  gathering money and resources and even obtaining legendary equipments.

[h2][b]More than twenty kinds of new enemies:[/b][/h2]

We have added more than 20 kinds of new enemies (caravan guards, robbers, monsters, etc.) to the game, many of which are fierce monsters that will appear in the hunting monster mission. You can send gladiators to defeat and [b]capture[/b] these beasts, bring them back to your own arena to host unique Venationes. Bizarre beasts will bring you huge amount of reputation and ticket income.

[h2][b]Lots of new equipment and items:[/b][/h2]

In this update, we added a large number of new equipment items, many of which can only be obtained through missions. We won't list them here, leave it to the players to discover.

[h2][b]The character model has been completely reworked:[/b][/h2]

We re-created all the basic character models used in the game in higher definition. In addition, we have added a lot of new hairs and face prints to offer players more choices when customizing characters.

[h2][b]Significant sound improvements:[/b]
[/h2]
We have improved the sound performance of the entire game, adding new ambient sounds, gladiators and UI sound effects. Now, the sound effects of the game don't sound so dull.

[h2][b]The overall optimization of the game:[/b][/h2]

We have optimized the game in many ways. Now the memory consumption of the game has been significantly reduced, 8G memory can run stably and smoothly. In addition, we have optimized and improved a number of scenes that previously had frame drops, and now the frame rates of these scenes can be stabilized in an ideal range.

[h2][b]More updates:[/b][/h2]

1) At the request of many players, we have added 4k resolution and two widescreen resolutions.

2) Three types of material traders were added to the three black markets.

3) A new gladiator appearance animation (before the battle start) has been made, and the gladiator appearance animation can now be skipped.

4) Re-entered the entrance lens of each arena.

5) We have added some interaction between the gladiator and the players in player's arena.

6) In addition to the content listed above, this update also has a large number of unmentioned bug fixes and detail improvements.
[h2][b]
Localizations and Mac version :[/b][/h2]
     our originally planned multi-language localization will be added to the game in the next one month. At the same time, the MAC version of the Blackthorn Arena will also be released in two weeks. 

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delayed the release of the two, and thanks for your patience.

Finally, we wish you a happy game in the full version of the Blackthorns Arena!

If you have any feedbacks or bug reports, please leave comment as below and we will get back to you as soon as possible. Cheers!

2) Fixed a bug that could cause player cannot leave the blackmarket after sold a slave.

4) Fixed a bug related to bankruptcy event.

5) Fixed the bug that the shortcut button in the shortcut bar in the first battle was not clickable if player enables the automatic pause.

7) Fixed some bugs of text display on UI.

8) Fixed a bug where the story match could be participated before it actually happened.


[h1][b]Improvements:[/b][/h1]

3) Added a cooldown time display to the skill slots in the action bar.

[h1][b]New content:[/b][/h1]

[h3][i][b]1) New chapter:[/b][/i][/h3]

We present a whole new chapter for Blackthorn Arena ! This storyline will take place after the spring game and before the Grand Venations show. The legendary orc master has come to freeland! He will set up his own arena, and lead a group of brutal half-orc gladiators across all other arena. If the player is strong enough, the orc master will also fight the player in person!

[h3][i][b]2) New Arena :[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262817/adec582554d142e05daa4df7002932465c645e39.png[/img]

With the arrival of the orc master, there will be a new arena in the game. It will host its own competition like other arena and will also accept the challenge from players. The difference is that all the gladiators in this arena are Orcs!

[h3][i][b]3) New enemies :[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262817/dfc940953ccf0efe333e0f3f9cf43d3e44d21ee3.png[/img]
The orc master has 17 orc gladiators with different styles and unique skills. They will become strong enemies for players in the middle and late game period.

[h3][i][b]4) New legendary helmet :[/b][/i][/h3]

This helmet originally belonged to the orc master, defeat it and claim your reward!

[h3][i][b]5) 6 new steam achievements[/b][/i][/h3]

[h1][b]New Functions:
[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]1)  Feasting:[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]2) Battle practice: [/b][/h3]
Add a Practice button to the training ground. After pressing, players can select two gladiators to perform a practice battle in the octagon cage on the training ground. Players can control one of the gladiators. It ends when players defeat  opponent. However, players can exit at any time.

[h3][b]3) Added a death memorial system to the treatment room:[/b][/h3]
Clicking on the Dead list button in the treatment room will now open a panel to browse all dead gladiators. Dead gladiator's icon, name, cause of death and time of death will be all displayed on it.


[h1][b]Balanced adjustment:[/b][/h1]

1) We have made a huge change to the battle mode, the purpose is to slightly increase the battle time, slower the battle pace while making the battle more strategic and ornamental.
The specific changes are as follows:

1. The three fighting styles have been differentiated, and each fighting style has distinctive characteristics:

[h3][b]- Aggressive style:[/b][/h3]
The character will attack the opponent with 100% attack frequency. Characters will immediately launch the next attack if they have enough stamina and are not in attack cooldowns.

[h3][b]- Cautious style:[/b][/h3]
The character will attack the opponent with 75% of the attack frequency, however, the accuracy of the attack is increased by 25%.

[h3][b]- Defensive Style:[/b][/h3]
The character will only attack the opponent with 50% of the attack frequency, however, the dodge and block rate will increase by 25% from the original.

At the same time we also introduced a new fighting style: Retention Style 

[h3][b]- Retention Style: [/b][/h3]
In this mode, the character will attack the opponent with 100% of the attack frequency, but when the Stamina drops below 25%, the character will no longer launch the attack, and will not continue to attack at 100% frequency until the Stamina recovers above 75%.

2. All weapon-based skills will be restricted by the attack interval. In other words, it is not possible to cast a weapon skill immediately after performing a normal attack, but have to wait until the cooldown of the normal attack is over.

3. The initial maximum Stamina of the character and the maximum Stamina bonus provided by the equipment are all halved. Now the aggressive combat style can only burst a shor amount of time.

2). Reduced the attribute requirements of most skills so plays have less restrictions on building their gladiators.

notes.title: Feb 17th Major Update! (Plenty of New Content)
notes.content:
Dear Blackthorn Arena player:
       Hello everyone, starting from this week, we will focus on adding new content  (new systems, new equipment, new mechanisms, new genres, etc.) as well as fix a few minor bugs. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to leave your comments below. We will try our best to improve as soon as possible.


PS: Dear players, we have just improved the way game resources are packaged so that the volume of subsequent updates and the disk space occupied by this game are as small as possible, however, the downloads of this and the next major updates will be fairly large. We apologize for any inconvenience that may cause you. Thank you for your understanding.

[b]BUG fix:[/b]

1) Fixed a bug where characters with "benevolence" and "cruelty" did not correctly increase obedience when the player chose the opponent's life or death.

2) Fixed an animation error after the lizard man was stunned.

3) Fixed a bug where some monsters were not correctly translated into Chinese when players held Venations.

4) Fixed a bug where the "Trace Arrow" skill did not properly apply Debuff to the target.

5) Fixed an issue where the Execute Shoot's additional damage was incorrect.

6) Fixed a bug where Evasion could not properly transfer the target's hatred.

7) Fixed a bug where the skill "Break free" in the duelist genre could not properly remove the movement restriction effects.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

1) The crafting page now shows the required skill levels.

2) Add a cancel button where players could cancel the treatment process in the treatment room.

3) Improved the buff's information display, now you can see more specific information through it.

4) Improved display of skill requirements. Skills will now display information such as genre not learned, required attribute points and levels.

5) Added some missing UI localization (in Chinese).

6) Improved the layout of gladiator tooltip pannel. Make it more legible.

7) The Action Bar will now be displayed when viewing the details of the Gladiator (originally only displayed when viewing the Skill item).

8) Reduced the duration of floating text when the skill is released.

[b]New Content:[/b]

1) Added a new guard system:
    Many players must have noticed that the main Hall, training ground, treatment room,  torture chamber, and the smithy all have corresponding functions. Only the gladiator cells look superfluous. Well, here it comes.

Guard system: A guard column has been added to the gladiator's cell. Players can hire guards to manage their gladiators in order to reduce the frequency of gladiators trying to escape.  
Gladiators with low loyalty may launch riots or escape now. If the guard failed to stop them or been defeated, the gladiator will escape forever!

2) Add two new genres :

- Berserker: Berserker's fighting style is very wild and aggressive. In their battle, they ignored their own safety and attacked their opponents madly. They often fight more and more bravely and will be the most dangerous enemy when they are on the verge of death.

- Marksman: Unlike Rangers, Marksman is very good at sniping enemies from a long distance. They rarely miss arrows and can cause many negative effects on opponents. However, the marksman will be extremely vulnerable after being approached by the enemy.

3) Added the feature of removing traits: the torture chamber can now remove the negative traits of the character through torture, however,  it will consume a long time and gladiators' health.

4) Added material system: Now almost all blacksmiths, chefs and doctors need certain materials to craft their recipes. These materials can be obtained by participating in competitions or purchased from street merchants.

5) Added 7 new recipes to the chefs for research: their materials need to be killed by different monsters in the Venations.

6) Added a Death immune potion recipe to the doctor, which will avoid the next complete death in battle after drinking.

7) Added a Loyalty potion recipe to the doctor, which will increase gladiators' 
Obedience after drinking.

8) Added an Amnesia Potion recipe to the doctor, which will return all potential points and skill points spent on weapon skills and genres for that gladiator after drinking.

9) Add some pictures to the events.

[b]Balance adjustment:[/b]

[b]General:[/b]

1) Improve the Genre skill system:
The original genre skills need to learn a pre-skill to unlock, but we found that there is no obvious logical relationship between many skills and their pre-skills. 
This kind of dependency is not reasonable and will cause players to waste their skill points on completely unused skills. Now, we have eliminated the pre-skill requirements of all genre and changed them to the requirements of levels and attributes. 
Such changes make the game's point system more balanced and more reasonable

2) New Weight system and Weight penalty:
Medium and heavy gladiator armors will no longer increase stamina exertion and reduce movement speed. Instead, it will be replaced by a weight system. All the equipment of the gladiator will increase the weight of the gladiator. When the gladiator's weight exceeds 25% of the total weight, the movement speed, stamina savings, and dodge would get reduced. The higher the weight, the higher the penalty. Strength attributes can increase the weight of a character.

3) Players will now see the winning probability of the Venations and exhibition match on the battle interface, however, players will no longer be able to send gladiators to participate in the league.

4) Slightly increased the winning probability when players send gladiators to participate in the Venations.

5) Improved the calculation method of the winning and losing ratio of sending gladiators to participate in matches 

6) Gladiators now have a chance to reduce their loyalty if they participate in matches if their health is less than 50%  or morale below 30%. The lower the status, the higher the chance.

7) Increased damage resistance cap from 75% to 85%.

8) The buff gained from special foods are nerfed, and the buffs from multiple foods will not overlap. The buffs gained from the last food will overwrite those from the previous food.

9) Increased the chance that a gladiator will acquire the corresponding trait after killing various types of monsters.

10) All NPC gladiators will receive certain attribute bonuses in Chapters 2 and 3 (After the Spring Game). The bonus value will be depended on difficulty.

[b]Skill:[/b]
